correctness.rationale: Exact Lagrangian identities reduce the observables to integrals over the newborn zero interval. The quadratic minimum gives Q=(delta-kappa h^2)/2+o(delta); exact integration gives width 4R_*/(15 sqrt(kappa)) delta^{5/2} and height 2R_*/(3 sqrt(kappa)) delta^{3/2}. The first-break cusp expansion gives C_*^5=(20^3/6^5)R_*^2/kappa, yielding the stated constants and ratio.
